connector.name: Nanocart MCP
connector.registryDescription: Manage your NanoCart store from any AI agent: products, orders, coupons, subscribers, reports.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.nanocart.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package nanocart-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bytebunny-io account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

env.name: NANOCART_API_KEY
env.description: Your NanoCart Admin API key (portal.nanocart.io -> Settings -> API Keys)

env.name: NANOCART_STORE_ID
env.description: Your store ID / slug (portal.nanocart.io -> Settings -> Store Information)
